name: codeterminal-vscode
description: A local-first AI coding assistant. Your code is indexed, embedded and retrieved on your own machine.

codeterminal.apiBase.markdownDescription:
Model API base URL the daemon talks to, e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`. Leave empty to use the daemon's default. Overrides `CODETERMINAL_API_BASE` in the environment.

This setting is **machine-scoped on purpose**: a workspace `.vscode/settings.json` must not be able to redirect your prompts to a host the repository chooses.

scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:helper && node scripts/stage-runtime.js
scripts.pretest: tsc -p ./ && npm run check:webview && npm run check:installpath
scripts.package: npm run verify:vsix:selftest && npm run build:runtime && tsc -p ./ && vsce package --no-dependencies -o codeterminal-vscode-$npm_package_version.vsix && node scripts/verify-vsix.js codeterminal-vscode-$npm_package_version.vsix
